scope: 27 configured Tailmance markets. Source-level legal and legal-language completion is separated from live production/store/provider/operator evidence; countries outside the configured 27 are out of scope for this inventory.

critical_journey_and_visual_evidence.note: Maestro selectors/flows are source-implemented; release-candidate device execution and visual golden evidence must be captured externally.

pending_items.notes: Production App Attest entitlement, server challenge, attestation and assertion verification must be exercised on supported physical iOS hardware.
Play Integrity Standard requests and server-side verdict verification must be exercised from a Play-distributed production-equivalent build.
A controlled native crash must arrive in the production Sentry project with source maps/native symbols and without prohibited PII.

App Store Server Notifications V2 must be connected for sandbox and production through the chosen RevenueCat/store architecture, and a recent signed JWS notification delivery must be verified end-to-end.
Google Play RTDN/PubSub must be connected to RevenueCat and confirmed with a test notification / recent delivery timestamp.

RevenueCat webhook high-entropy Authorization plus HMAC-SHA256 signing over the exact raw body, five-minute signature timestamp tolerance, exact PRODUCTION/SANDBOX environment binding, app allowlist, retry behavior, idempotent ledger and RevenueCat REST reconciliation must be exercised against the deployed Edge Function.
Purchase, restore, renewal, cancellation, refund/revocation and account-transfer scenarios must be tested end-to-end on both stores.

Source implements production native Turnstile challenge flow for email sign-in/sign-up, password reset and phone OTP using CSPRNG state, HTTPS challenge page, action/state-bound deep-link callback and Supabase captchaToken. Before release, verify the hosted Turnstile widget/site key, hosted Supabase Auth CAPTCHA setting/secret, physical-device return flow, expiry/cancel/error handling and rate-limit interaction in production.
MFA, screen-capture protection, background/resume, push lifecycle, account switch/logout, deep links and permission prompts must pass on representative physical iOS/Android devices.

Verify production iOS APNs/PushKit VoIP and Android FCM V1 credentials are configured for the exact Tailmance bundle/package and EAS project; APNs VoIP uses the exact bundle .voip topic and production signing key, while ordinary Expo tokens remain a separate transport. On representative devices verify Expo push plus iOS killed/background incoming-call CallKit wakeup, Android Telecom incoming-call behavior, token rotation/account switch/logout cleanup, invalid/unregistered token retirement, recipient binding and deep-link/call routing without exposing payload secrets.

Verify LIVEKIT_ROOM_REAPER_SECRET is provisioned, the livekit-room-reaper Edge Function is scheduled with overlapping-run protection, worker health/alerts are monitored, and representative decline/end/hard-expiry/account-deletion scenarios physically delete the LiveKit room and disconnect all participants. Exercise provider outage/recovery to prove the transactional outbox retries until cleanup completes without retaining completed operational rows.

Production Supabase/functions/web endpoints must pass an external TLS and response-header scan showing HTTPS-only service, modern protocol/cipher configuration, valid chain/hostname, no unintended cleartext listener/redirect downgrade, HSTS where appropriate, nosniff/referrer protections, and an HTTP-delivered CSP for sensitive web surfaces. The hosted auth challenge must enforce frame-ancestors via the HTTP CSP response header because meta CSP cannot provide authoritative frame-ancestor enforcement.

Inventory every production mobile endpoint and record the transport-identity decision per host. For first-party endpoints whose TLS keys and rotation are operationally controlled, either implement/test public-key (SPKI) pinning with at least one independent backup pin and a rotation/recovery plan, or document a reviewed risk decision. Do not hard-code brittle single-leaf pins for managed third-party endpoints such as Apple, Google, RevenueCat or managed Supabase certificates whose rotation Tailmance does not control. Verify the final store binaries against this inventory.

Dependency-resolved App Store archive must be inspected for merged PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy, third-party SDK manifests/signatures and Required Reason API declarations; reasons must match actual use and App Privacy answers.

Inspect the actual store-ready Android App Bundle and iOS archive: production signing only, no debuggable/test flags or secrets, Android R8/resource shrinking actually applied with mapping retained privately, iOS shipped symbols stripped as appropriate while dSYM/source maps are uploaded privately, entitlements/permissions match the approved allowlist, and release network/privacy settings are present in the generated artifacts.

Production moderation must be exercised against the configured provider on representative multilingual text/image abuse classes, with sampled false-positive/false-negative review, a working manual-review queue, staffed report handling/contact path, and a documented response/escalation SLA. Source wiring alone cannot prove live classifier quality or operational coverage.

Exercise the exact production text/image moderation provider and policy configuration against representative multilingual abuse classes; record sampled false-positive/false-negative review, provider failure/manual-review fallback, staffed report-handling ownership, response/escalation SLA, and illegal-content/emergency escalation. Provider DPA/data-region and retention settings must match the approved privacy data map.
Production environment variables, secrets, key rotation/ownership and absence of dev/test credentials must be verified from the deployed projects. Source placeholders are not evidence.

Verify the production Google Maps Android API key is restricted in Google Cloud to the exact Android application package and release signing certificate fingerprint, and API-restricted to only the Maps Platform APIs/SDKs Tailmance actually uses. Record the production credential/configuration evidence without exposing the key itself.

Verify deployed production database, object storage, backups/snapshots and provider-managed replicas are encrypted at rest with the approved cryptographic/KMS configuration; record key ownership/custody, access controls, rotation/revocation process, backup encryption and restore behavior, and provider evidence without exposing secret key material. SQLCipher/local app encryption and private buckets do not by themselves prove server-side AES-256/KMS encryption.

A real dependency resolution must produce a committed lockfile and reproducible clean install/build evidence. Do not fabricate a package-lock.json or infer dependency integrity from package.json alone.
The exact App Store / Play candidate binaries must be cryptographically identified and matched to the audited source, configuration, signing identities and release evidence.
Exercise the deployed legal-country resolver and immutable-bundle routing with real production-equivalent data for supported, mismatched, expired, unknown and subnational cases; no source-only PASS.

Where a jurisdiction requires age assurance beyond self-attestation, verify the selected production provider/process, evidence quality, minimization, retention, failure handling and jurisdiction-specific routing.

Verify deployed Supabase Auth settings match source intent: 15-minute JWT expiry, refresh-token rotation/reuse interval, email confirmation, secure password change, redirect allowlist, TOTP availability, auth rate limits and the chosen production anti-bot challenge path. Also verify Apple and Google OAuth providers are enabled with the exact production client/service IDs and secrets, callback/redirect URIs are allowlisted, and physical-device sign-in plus account-link flows complete without open redirect or identity-confusion behavior. Source config alone does not prove hosted dashboard state.

Exercise the production incident runbook against all 27 configured-market obligation rows, including awareness/detection/determination clocks, evidence preservation, authority/data-subject routing, phased notices, subnational escalation, designated legal/privacy escalation contacts, and immutable incident records. A desk matrix alone is not operational proof.

Deploy the external account-deletion web path and enter that exact HTTPS URL in Play Console Data safety/account deletion. Verify the route initiates deletion without requiring app access and accurately describes legally required retention.

Verify the live monthly Premium product is configured at the intended USD 14.99 base price in the designated base storefront and that App Store / Google Play localized storefront pricing, renewal terms and applicable tax/VAT/KDV presentation match the native purchase sheet. The app must render the store-provided localized price string and must not calculate or append client-side tax.

Exercise the production health-verification provider/OCR/clinic-signature path end-to-end with representative vaccination, neutering, microchip and genetic/pedigree evidence. Confirm signed webhook delivery, clinic public identifier accuracy, false-positive/false-negative review, expiry/revocation behavior, provider DPA/retention/data-region settings, and that no raw provider reference or health-document content is exposed on public pet surfaces.

external_legal_operational_evidence.note: Only live/operational evidence belongs here. Source-remediable legal/language work is not an external blocker.

universal_app_link_association.note: Association files are generated only from verified production identity values; live HTTPS hosting and platform verification remain external evidence.
